from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialItem(BaseModel):
    """A financial line item extracted from a single company's report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company reported in this document")
    line_item_name: str | None = Field(description="The financial line item name (e.g. '专项储备')")
    value: str | None = Field(description="The reported value, or empty string/None if not present; preserve exact formatting")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit (e.g. '元', 'CNY')")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="Date as of which the figure is reported")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the extracted item")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_items: list[FinancialItem]
